passage:
**Items sold at Aling Nena's sari-sari store**

| Item | Monday | Tuesday | Wednesday |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bread | 24 | 30 | 18 |
| Eggs | 36 | 28 | 40 |
| Coffee sachets | 15 | 22 | 19 |
| Soft drinks | 12 | 16 | 20 |
stem: Which item sold the most on Wednesday?
hints: Look only at the Wednesday column.
Read the four numbers in the Wednesday column, one for each item.
Find the largest number in the Wednesday column, then read the item name at the start of its row.

solution.methodName: Compare within one column, then read the row

steps.why: The question is only about Wednesday, so ignore the other days.

steps.action: Read its numbers: Bread 18, Eggs 40, Coffee sachets 19, Soft drinks 20.
Find the largest: 40 is more than 20, 19 and 18.
40 is in the Eggs row, so eggs sold the most on Wednesday.

trapNotes.Bread: Bread sold the most on Tuesday (30), but the question asks about Wednesday. On Wednesday, bread sold only 18.
trapNotes.Coffee sachets: Coffee sachets sold only 19 on Wednesday. Compare all four numbers in the Wednesday column.
trapNotes.Soft drinks: Soft drinks had their best day on Wednesday (20), but eggs sold even more that day (40).
